usage_examples.mt: Għandna għaġla kbira llum biex inlestu kollox.
usage_examples.en: We are in a great hurry today to finish everything.

usage_examples.mt: L-għaġla ġġib l-iżbalji, għalhekk ħu ħinok.
usage_examples.en: Haste makes mistakes, so take your time.

usage_examples.mt: Ma għoġobnix l-għaġla tiegħu meta tkellem.
usage_examples.en: I did not like his haste when he spoke.

usage_examples.mt: Kienet deċiżjoni għaġlija li ġiet segwita b'dispjaċir.
usage_examples.en: It was a hasty decision that was followed by regret.

usage_examples.mt: Tkunx għaġli wisq fl-eżamijiet tiegħek.
usage_examples.en: Do not be too hasty in your exams.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħobż kellu konsistenza għaġnija wara li ħallieh għal sagħtejn.
usage_examples.en: The bread had a doughlike consistency after leaving it for two hours.

usage_examples.mt: It-taħlita kienet għaġnija wisq, għalhekk żidt ftit ilma.
usage_examples.en: The mixture was too doughlike, so I added some water.

usage_examples.mt: Tkunx għaġuli fid-deċiżjonijiet importanti ta' ħajtek.
usage_examples.en: Do not be hasty in the important decisions of your life.

usage_examples.mt: Ir-risposta tiegħu kienet għaġulija wisq u ma ħsiebx sew.
usage_examples.en: His answer was too hasty and he did not think properly.

usage_examples.mt: Il-mexxej għaġuli spiss jagħmel żbalji.
usage_examples.en: The hasty leader often makes mistakes.

usage_examples.mt: Il-għaġuż kien joqgħod waħdu fir-raħal.
usage_examples.en: The old man used to live alone in the village.

usage_examples.mt: Sibna għaġuż żgħir taħt il-blata ħdejn il-baħar.
usage_examples.en: We found a small shore crab under the rock by the sea.

definitions.text_en: female equivalent of għaġuż: old woman

usage_examples.mt: Il-għaġuża kienet tbigħ il-ħobż kull filgħodu.
usage_examples.en: The old woman used to sell bread every morning.

usage_examples.mt: Il-għaġuża tatni parir tajjeb dwar il-ħajja.
usage_examples.en: The old woman gave me good advice about life.

usage_examples.mt: Il-prestazzjoni tiegħu għaġġbet lil kulħadd.
usage_examples.en: His performance amazed everyone.

usage_examples.mt: L-aħbar li rebħu l-lotterija għaġġbithom kompletament.
usage_examples.en: The news that they won the lottery astonished them completely.

usage_examples.mt: Għaġġel inkella se nidħlu tard fil-klassi.
usage_examples.en: Hurry up or we will be late for class.

usage_examples.mt: Il-karozza għaġġlet il-veloċità tagħha malajr wisq.
usage_examples.en: The car accelerated its speed too quickly.

usage_examples.mt: Jekk tgħaġġel ix-xogħol, tista' tagħmel żbalji.
usage_examples.en: If you hasten the work, you might make mistakes.

definitions.text_en: a disused Maltese custom where neighbors cooked a meal for a grieving family, who refrained from cooking to avoid worsening the fire of purgatory

usage_examples.mt: Il-għaża kienet drawwa sabiħa fost il-familji Maltin tal-imgħoddi.
usage_examples.en: The għaża was a beautiful custom among Maltese families of the past.

usage_examples.mt: Illum il-ġurnata l-għaża m'għadhiex tiġi prattikata daqs qabel.
usage_examples.en: Nowadays the għaża is no longer practised as before.

definitions.text_en: to comfort (someone) in times of mourning, to offer condolences, to console, to declare regret for someone's loss

usage_examples.mt: Marru jagħżu lill-familja wara l-mewt ta' nannithom.
usage_examples.en: They went to offer condolences to the family after the death of their grandmother.

usage_examples.mt: Ġie jagħżina f'dak iż-żmien diffiċli ta' ħajjitna.
usage_examples.en: He came to comfort us in that difficult time of our lives.

definitions.text_en: to dig (a field) over, to hoe
to do poorly (in an exam or task)

usage_examples.mt: Il-bidwi għażaq l-għalqa kollha qabel ma żera' ż-żerriegħa.
usage_examples.en: The farmer dug over the whole field before sowing the seed.

usage_examples.mt: Għażaq fl-eżami tal-matematika għax ma studjax biżżejjed.
usage_examples.en: He did poorly in the maths exam because he did not study enough.

usage_examples.mt: Jekk ma tgħażqix l-art, il-ħaxix ħażin jikber.
usage_examples.en: If you do not hoe the land, the weeds will grow.

usage_examples.mt: Ħu l-kbir għadu għażeb u jgħix ma' ġenituri.
usage_examples.en: My elder brother is still a bachelor and lives with our parents.

usage_examples.mt: Kien għażeb sal-eta' ta' erbgħin sena qabel iżżewweġ.
usage_examples.en: He was a bachelor until the age of forty before he got married.

usage_examples.mt: Il-libsa kienet magħmula mill-għażel l-aktar fin.
usage_examples.en: The dress was made of the finest linen.

usage_examples.mt: Is-sajjied tefa' l-għażel fil-baħar u stenna bil-paċenzja.
usage_examples.en: The fisherman cast the net into the sea and waited patiently.

definitions.text_en: to give preferential treatment, favor [with minn]

usage_examples.mt: Għażilt l-aħjar ktieb mill-ixkaffa tal-librerija.
usage_examples.en: I chose the best book from the library shelf.

usage_examples.mt: In-nanna kienet tagħżel is-suf bil-galbu u bil-ħila.
usage_examples.en: Grandmother used to spin the wool carefully and skilfully.

usage_examples.mt: Il-qattus għażel bil-kwiet hekk kif tmissajtu.
usage_examples.en: The cat purred softly as I stroked it.

definitions.text_en: superseded spelling of għażżaż: to gnaw, gnash
definitions.text_mt: Ortografija qadima ta' għażżaż: tgħażżaż, tigdim

usage_examples.mt: Dik l-ortografija tal-kelma m'għadhiex tintuża llum.
usage_examples.en: That spelling of the word is no longer used today.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kelma 'għażgħaż' illum tinkiteb 'għażżaż' skont l-ortografija moderna.
usage_examples.en: The word 'għażgħaż' is now written 'għażżaż' according to modern spelling.

definitions.text_en: verbal noun of għażel (“ to spin ”)
verbal noun of għażel (“ to choose, select ”)

usage_examples.mt: Il-għażil tas-suf kien xogħol komuni fid-djar Maltin ta' qabel.
usage_examples.en: The spinning of wool was common work in Maltese homes of old.

usage_examples.mt: Il-għażil tal-aqwa kandidati sar mill-kumitat wara diskussjoni twila.
usage_examples.en: The selection of the best candidates was done by the committee after a long discussion.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa wieħed mill-aktar ħbieb għażież li għandi.
usage_examples.en: He is one of the dearest friends that I have.

usage_examples.mt: Din il-memorja tibqa' għażiża għal qalbi għal dejjem.
usage_examples.en: This memory will remain cherished in my heart forever.

usage_examples.mt: Għandek ħafna għażliet fuq il-menu tal-lum.
usage_examples.en: You have many choices on today's menu.

usage_examples.mt: Din kienet l-aqwa għażla li stajna nagħmlu.
usage_examples.en: This was the best choice we could have made.

usage_examples.mt: Il-għażla tal-istudenti eċċellenti saret mis-surmast.
usage_examples.en: The selection of the excellent students was made by the headmaster.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa xerrej għażli u jfittex dejjem l-aħjar kwalità.
usage_examples.en: He is a selective buyer and always looks for the best quality.

usage_examples.mt: Is-suq tal-ġojjellerija huwa għażli ħafna f'dawn il-jiem.
usage_examples.en: The jewellery market is very selective these days.

usage_examples.mt: Tmexxielna nagħmlu l-għażwa lill-familja kollha.
usage_examples.en: We managed to pay a condolence visit to the whole family.

usage_examples.mt: In-nies tal-irħula kienu jagħmlu l-għażwa spiss fi żmien il-imgħoddi.
usage_examples.en: Villagers used to make condolence visits often in times past.

usage_examples.mt: L-għażż huwa l-akbar għadu tal-bniedem li jrid jirnexxi.
usage_examples.en: Laziness is the greatest enemy of a person who wants to succeed.

usage_examples.mt: L-għażż tiegħu wasslu biex jitlef ħafna opportunitajiet.
usage_examples.en: His laziness caused him to lose many opportunities.

usage_examples.mt: Uriew għażż lejn il-problemi tal-komunità tagħhom.
usage_examples.en: They showed indifference towards the problems of their community.

usage_examples.mt: Jien ngħożż il-memorji tal-ġenituri tiegħi qabel mietu.
usage_examples.en: I cherish the memories of my parents before they died.

usage_examples.mt: Għożż il-ħbieb veri tiegħek għax huma rari.
usage_examples.en: Cherish your true friends because they are rare.

usage_examples.mt: Japprezza u jgħożż kull mument li jqatta' ma' uliedu.
usage_examples.en: He appreciates and cherishes every moment he spends with his children.

definitions.text_en: to offer condolences, to console, to declare regret for someone's loss

usage_examples.mt: Għażżejna lill-familja wara t-telfa kbira tagħhom.
usage_examples.en: We offered our condolences to the family after their great loss.

usage_examples.mt: Il-qassis għażża lill-armla u lil uliedha bil-ħniena.
usage_examples.en: The priest consoled the widow and her children with compassion.

definitions.text_en: to embrace, to clasp someone tight

usage_examples.mt: Il-kelb għażżaż l-għadma bil-ħerqa kollha.
usage_examples.en: The dog gnawed the bone with great eagerness.

usage_examples.mt: Għażżażni f'dirgħajh meta rahni wara żmien twil.
usage_examples.en: He embraced me tightly in his arms when he saw me after a long time.

usage_examples.mt: Il-magna l-qadima għażżażet il-qamħ kollu f'inqas minn siegħa.
usage_examples.en: The old machine ground all the wheat in less than an hour.

definitions.text_en: to embrace, to clasp someone tight

usage_examples.mt: Ommu għażżetu dejjem u tatih l-aħjar kollox.
usage_examples.en: His mother always treated him with affection and gave him the best of everything.

usage_examples.mt: Il-qtates għażżu l-ħalib u gergru hekk kif ressqilhom il-kejk.
usage_examples.en: The cats lapped up the milk and growled as I brought them the cake.

usage_examples.mt: Għażżeżt lil ibni wara li waqa' u weġġa' rkopptejh.
usage_examples.en: I embraced my son tightly after he fell and hurt his knees.
